utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, okay, hi everyone. Can everyone hear me? Wei, you're on mute. No, you're good.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Great. So, agenda. Pricing for the analytics thing, the onboarding checklist, and, oh, did anyone watch the game last night? No? Never mind.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Can I just start with pricing, because I've got a-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Go, go.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: So I think we charge per seat for the analytics add-on. Twelve dollars a seat, per month.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Twelve flat, or...

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Per seat. Twelve per seat per month, that's the whole model.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Is that on top of the base plan?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: On top, yeah. Add-on.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Why per seat, though? Remind me, I was out when we did the beta recap.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Because it's, like, predictable. A buyer can do the math in their head, ten people, a hundred twenty dollars, done. And it grows with how many people are actually looking at the dashboards. The usage-based thing we tried in the beta confused everybody, remember? Nobody could forecast the bill.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The usage one was a mess. Support tickets, like, weekly.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Right, right. I remember a customer calling it a mystery bill.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Do we know who would actually buy it? Like, the size of the teams?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Good question, we can look at that later. Henrik, you're confident enough about this?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yes. Honestly I've looked at it for two weeks.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Tangent, sorry, my cousin's startup does per-seat and she says the annual billing bit is where they actually make, never mind, that's another meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'd want to check the account sizes at some point, but I don't have the data cleaned up yet.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sure, sure. For now, let's just go with per-seat pricing at twelve dollars for launch, and we revisit if anything looks off.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Done?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Done. Next. Onboarding checklist, Ingrid, you had notes?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Yeah, um, there are, like, eleven steps and I think six of them can go.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Eleven? It was seven when I last looked.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: It grew.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Which six?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: The ones that ask for stuff we already have. Company name, timezone. Those.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Kill them.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, Ingrid, send me the shorter list and I'll look. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Just that the pilot export finished, I'll go through it this week.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Good. Thanks all. And Wei, unmute yourself next time!

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I was unmuted.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Ha. Bye.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Alright, quick recap. We went per-seat at twelve, and Sven was going to dig into the pilot export.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I did. So, um, the pilot has five accounts, and three of them have teams over forty people. At twelve a seat that's over four hundred eighty a month for a typical bill, and two of those accounts told our success manager it felt steep.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Forty people, so what, that's the point, it scales-

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'm not done. Four-eighty is just the add-on. On top of their base plan.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Sorry, can I-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Ingrid, go.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: I think this is a problem. Big teams are going to look at a bill that grows every time they hire someone, and, um, they'll just balk. A flat price or tiers would keep us from losing the biggest accounts.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Tiers are way more complicated to explain.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Maybe. But I'd rather explain tiers than lose the big ones.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Can I do my thing before time's up? Separate topic.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yes, but let's park this first. Does anyone want to decide pricing now?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I don't think we need to.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, parked. Wei.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Demo day. I think we move the weekly demo from Friday afternoon to Thursday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Why?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Because Friday demos keep getting skipped. Half the team takes Friday off or leaves early. Last month we had like two real ones.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Honestly, yes.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: I'm out most Fridays, so Thursday's better for me.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Thursday's fine.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, then. The weekly demo moves to Thursday afternoons, starting next week.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Calendar invites, who does that? Wei?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Great. Back to pricing for two minutes, or, no, we're out of time. Next week, third meeting, let's make it first on the agenda.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'll bring the pilot data.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yes, bring the actual numbers on who said what.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I have a hard stop at the hour.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Everyone does. Thanks, all.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Wait, was the demo thing in the- never mind.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, pricing first today, like we said. So, where we are is per-seat at twelve was the plan, and then Sven showed us the pilot team sizes and Ingrid made a case about big teams. I think that deserves a proper second look before we lock it.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Can I answer that?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Three things. The three big accounts, they're on enterprise contracts, so their price gets negotiated anyway, nobody pays list. The two that said steep are free trial accounts, so they were never paying. And I checked the competitors, they all do per-seat at fifteen to twenty. Twelve leaves room.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Wait, the two that said steep were trials? I didn't have that.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I asked the success manager yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Hm. I can confirm that, it's in the export, I just didn't cross-reference.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: And the big ones, negotiated down to what?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Varies. Fifteen to thirty percent off, depending.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Okay, that's, that's a different picture.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Still think tiers are cleaner.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Tiers are cleaner for a spreadsheet, not for a buyer.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I'd, hm, I would rather not redesign the whole thing for two trial accounts.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: I'm okay if we watch it. What are we watching?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Churn among accounts over forty, after the first billing.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Can we put that on the dashboard?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I can add a filter.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, so, we're keeping per-seat pricing at twelve for launch.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Fine. Let's see the churn numbers in a month.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Agreed. Launch comms, next. Wei, is the landing page copy ready?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Draft's ready. The price is in it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Sorry, my camera froze, did I miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: No, just that we're done. Thanks, all.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Bye.
